description: List the projects (project-kind tags) in the space - the valid `project` values for recall, remember and publish. Narrow with `search`.

search.description: search optionally narrows projects by name substring.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: list_projects

hasPassword.description: has_password is true when the project admits anonymous viewers by password.

isInternal.description: is_internal excludes the project's collections from every anonymous view.

title: Projects in this workspace
